title: README FIRST  -  The Three-Layer Cannon

canonical_node.axiom: The Master Equation framework must be maintained in three distinct layers: formal, physical-theological, and teaching. Layer separation is the irreducible rule that prevents drift.
definitions: Layer 1 (Formal): typed mathematical spine, Definition 10 (ten factors with explicit domains) and Definition 11 (Master Equation as integral product). Lean-verified and locked.
Layer 2 (Physical-Theological): for each formal factor, two readings: physical law-form and spiritual law-form. Same algebra, two interpretations. Isomorphism claim lives here.
Layer 3 (Teaching): human-facing law chapters, negotiable, may have 9 or 10 chapters.
Factor: a typed mathematical object in Layer 1.
Law chapter: a human-facing explanatory unit in Layer 3.
C: the tenth factor, measures total integration locally.
chi: the integrated output, the product integrated over space and time.
S_eff: effective entropy production, defined as e^(-*S_prod) or 1/(1+S_prod), mapping 0 to (0,1] and antitone in S_prod.
derivation: Fifteen-month framework drift diagnosed as collapse of three layers into one document.
Fix is layer separation: three documents, one per layer.
Layer 1 has 10 formal factors, always 10, locked. Layer 3 has 9 or 10 teaching chapters, negotiable. They are not the same number-question.
C is the tenth factor; chi is the integrated output. The product never includes chi inside itself.
Entropy sign repair: raw entropy production cannot multiply coherence directly; it enters through S_eff = e^(-*S_prod) or 1/(1+S_prod), both antitone in S_prod.
Lean kernel verifies seven structural properties of the Master Equation.
canonical_node.action: Maintain the three-layer separation. Use Layer 1 as source of truth for math. Use Layer 2 for paper bridge equations. Use Layer 3 for public communication. Apply the Three-Layer Reconciliation Test to verify any claim.
boundary: Does not define the specific formal factors or the Master Equation itself; that is Layer 1's content.
Does not provide the physical and spiritual interpretations; that is Layer 2's content.
Does not fix the number of teaching chapters; Layer 3 is negotiable.
Does not prove the isomorphism claim; it only states where the claim lives.
Does not provide the Lean kernel code or its full verification details; it references the kernel.
test: Three-Layer Reconciliation Test: (1) Does the public claim reduce to a Layer 2 pairing (2) Does the Layer 2 pairing reduce to a Layer 1 factor (3) Does the Layer 1 factor have its formal domain and verified property in the Lean kernel If all three pass, claim is consistent; if any fails, drift has appeared.
Check that Layer 1 always has 10 factors and is locked.
Check that Layer 3 may have 9 or 10 chapters without affecting Layer 1.
Check that C and chi are distinct: product never includes chi inside itself.
Check that S_eff is antitone in S_prod and maps 0 to (0,1].

dg1_dependencies: Layer 1 formal definitions (Definition 10 and 11) as referenced.
Lean kernel verification artifact as referenced.
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a meta-rule for organizing and maintaining the Master Equation framework across three layers, preventing drift by separating formal, interpretive, and teaching concerns.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the formal Layer 1 as the locked source of truth, and preserves the Lean kernel as the canonical verification artifact.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If this layer separation is removed, the framework collapses into a single document, causing drift and making failure points unfindable.
dg5_translation_registers: Formal factor  physical law-form  spiritual law-form (Layer 2 isomorphism)
Layer 1 factor  Layer 3 teaching chapter (not necessarily one-to-one)

classification.recommended_atom_action: preserve as structural directive; do not treat as mathematical proof

overstatement_risks: Claiming that the Lean kernel verifies the Master Equation itself, when it only verifies seven structural properties.
Claiming that the isomorphism between physical and spiritual readings is proven, when it is only declared to live in Layer 2.
Claiming that the three-layer separation is sufficient to prevent all drift, when it is a proposed fix.
kill_conditions: If Layer 1 is not actually Lean-verified or is changed without updating this document.
If the Lean kernel does not exist or does not verify the claimed properties.
If the three-layer separation is not implemented in the actual documents.
risk.lean_target: The Lean kernel verifies the antitone property of S_eff and other structural properties of the Master Equation, but not the full framework or its interpretations.

plain_summary: This document is a meta-instruction that mandates separating the Master Equation framework into three layers: formal (math), physical-theological (interpretation), and teaching (explanation). It describes the fix for drift and outlines a reconciliation test. It references a Lean kernel that verifies seven structural properties, but does not itself provide mathematical proofs or establish the isomorphism claim.
